name: Eigenvalues and the SVD
description: Find the directions a matrix only stretches, and use the SVD to pull structure out of data.

lessonNames.l7-covariance-psd: Why a covariance matrix is positive semidefinite

lessonObjectives.l1-directions-that-stay: Find the vectors a matrix only stretches.
lessonObjectives.l3-eigenbasis: Diagonalise a matrix and use it to compute powers quickly.
lessonObjectives.l4-where-it-settles: Find a steady state as the eigenvector with eigenvalue 1.
lessonObjectives.l5-perpendicular-eigenvectors: Use the spectral theorem for symmetric matrices.
lessonObjectives.l6-bowls: Test a matrix for positive definiteness in several ways.
lessonObjectives.l7-covariance-psd: Show that any covariance matrix is positive semidefinite.
lessonObjectives.l8-ellipses: Read the shape of a quadratic form from its eigenvalues.
lessonObjectives.l10-biggest-pieces: Approximate a matrix with its largest singular values.
lessonObjectives.l11-principal-components: Find the principal components of data from its covariance matrix.
lessonObjectives.l12-yield-curve: Run PCA on yield curve changes in NumPy and name the factors.
